description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; each call uses one AI analysis from the licence quota. Reviews a contract or general terms and conditions the buyer is asked to sign, clause by clause (term, renewal, notice, price adjustment, payment, liability, warranty, penalties, acceptance, exclusivity, data protection, jurisdiction). Returns a summary and, per clause, the exact reference, the plain-language meaning, a rating (ok, pruefen = check, kritisch = critical), why it matters for the buyer and a counter-proposal; deadline dates only when the start date is known. Also returns datenblatt, the key data of the contract as stated (supplier, subject, target value, payment terms, items) for entry into an ERP or accounting system. Pass the full contract text (extract text from PDFs or images first). Not legal advice. The text is processed for this answer only and is not stored by KULIC Advisory.

contract_start.description: Optional contract start, YYYY-MM-DD, to compute notice dates.

contract_text.description: Full text of the contract or the terms and conditions.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

name: review_contract
title: Review a contract or terms and conditions from the buyer side (AICTIONBOT™ clause radar)
